predecessors.name: Duchy of Saxe-Gotha-Altenburg
predecessors.text: the Duchy of Saxe-Altenburg from 1826: the Ostkreis (Altenburg, Schmölln, Gößnitz, Lucka, Meuselwitz, Ronneburg) and the Westkreis (Eisenberg, Kahla, Orlamünde, Roda); 1,323 km2 in 1905

successors.name: Weimar Republic
successors.text: the state as it stood in 1870, unchanged to November 1918 (Free State of Saxe-Altenburg)

ledger.x: 12 November 1826: the Duchy of Saxe-Altenburg is re-created for Duke Friedrich.
November 1918: the duchy ends in the German Revolution.

certainty.note: A small state with administrative boundaries and exclaves (the Sachsen-Altenburg page names Mumsdorf, Roschütz, Hilbersdorf, Neukirchen, Rußdorf and Ammelstädt); the grid outline cannot draw them.
